2. Modified Assured Career Progression Schemes (MACPS) extended to Department of Posts:  
The above scheme (MACPS) is also extended to the Department of Posts (except Drivers) replacing the existing schemes of Time Bound One Promotion (TBOP) and Biennial Cadre Review (BCR) with effect from 1-9-2008. The terms and conditions are applicable as per MACPS, OM, dated 19-5-2009. - OM, dated 18-9-2009.
